properties.bedrock_type: Calciferous Sandstone Measures (Lower Carboniferous) and intrusive dolerite sills
properties.mineralogy: Fine-grained quartz arenite sandstone, siltstone, basaltic volcanic tuffs, and glacial boulder clay till
properties.drainage: Steep dendritic alluvial incision via the incised gorge of the Water of Leith

properties.primary_surfacing: Granite setts, whinstone kerbstones, compacted river-gravel pathways, and mortared sandstone retaining embankments
properties.wear_characteristics: Wagon iron-wheel ruts, damp river-gorge moss accumulation along lower retaining revetments, and unpaved mud edges
properties.micro_grading: Steep terraced riverside valley floor rising to sheer structural gorge retaining walls

properties.groundcover: Riverbank riparian grasses, herbaceous weeds, damp moss patches, and autumn leaf litter

properties.primary_building_typology: Scots Baronial & Vernacular Revival Tenements and Milling Complexes (Dean Village / Well Court)

structures.name: Well Court Complex (Primary Scots Baronial Tenement & Clock Tower)
structures.roof_geometry: Steep pitched roofs with crow-stepped gables, conical corner turrets, dormers, and prominent 26m octagonal clock tower
structures.facade_material: Pinkish-red Hailes and Craigleith sandstone ashlar and coursed squared rubble with red clay pantiles and Scotch slate
structures.weathering_patina: Pronounced late-Victorian industrial coal smoke and soot deposition in cornices, dripstones, and sheltered undercuts, with damp moss near water levels

structures.name: Eastern Riverside Tenements (Damside / Hawthornbank)
structures.roof_geometry: Steeply pitched Ballachulish slate roofs with dormer windows and tall masonry chimney stacks
structures.facade_material: Blonde Craigleith coursed rubble sandstone and lime harl
structures.weathering_patina: Moderate soot staining, iron oxide leaching beneath sills, and lime bloom

structures.name: Northern Terraced Housing Row (Historic Mill Cottages)
structures.roof_geometry: Pitched Scottish slate and clay pantile roofs with stepped parapets
structures.weathering_patina: Weather-worn lime wash, damp base course staining, and chimney carbon crusts

structures.name: Western Valley Cottages and Workshops
structures.roof_geometry: Low-pitched red pantile and slate gables
structures.weathering_patina: Heavily patinated riverside moisture marks and coal dust

period_vehicles: Horse-drawn dray cart with wooden-spoke iron-rimmed wheels
street_furniture: Cast-iron fluted gas lamp posts with square copper lanterns
pedestrian_profiles: Late-Victorian mill workers in woollen waistcoats and flat caps
Local residents in heavy tweed shawls and long dark aprons

properties.lighting_condition: Late-afternoon low-raking Golden Hour sunlight cutting across the incised valley, casting elongated warm shadows with cool indigo skylight in gorge recesses
